### **Summary**

Meeting focused on refining portal features and design standards with established development priorities and branding requirements.

**Refining portal navigation features**  
The team prioritized adding category filters and separating event history tabs. A decision was made to adjust the registration flow to require detailed confirmation rather than single-click sign-ups.

Requirements for artist profiles and transparency in participant selection were finalized. Technical guidance on web responsiveness and component sizing was established to maintain professional layout standards.

### **Decisions**

## Aligned

* **Upcoming and past events tabs added** The My Events section will feature separate tabs for upcoming and past events.

* **Registration details page flow adopted** The registration flow is updated to direct users to a details page first, requiring confirmation of participation rather than a single-click registration.

* **Discover Events category filter added** A category-based filter will be added to the Discover Events page.

* **Multiple video links allowed on profile** The artist profile will support the addition of multiple video links. \- make the links embedded \- detect youtube or vimeo links and make them embedded video format please on the profile page \- button to add more links.  
  Make sure to write that there you can enter whatever links you want but we support embedded vimeo or youtube links. \- they can upload any link \- \- but embedded support for these two platforms  \- others will be reflected as just links.

* **Sponsor section hidden on public profile** Sponsor-specific sections will be hidden on the artist's public profile.

* **Website URL input field standardized** Website URL input fields will be standardized to remove the requirement for entering 'https'.

* **Event details added to notifications** Notifications will be updated to explicitly display the associated event name. Make sure we include dynamic things throughout the platform and also include these dynamic terms in the admin profile too please.

* **Category-based event placeholder images added** Placeholder images will be implemented for events where no specific image is provided, categorized by type such as music or comedy. Use pexels website or any other website to make sure we get relevant free images but these should show only when there are no images added by the user for the event etc.

### **Details**

* **Personal Catch-up and Professional Context**: Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar exchanged updates regarding their personal circumstances, including current weather conditions and recent regional challenges like flooding and heat waves. Sakshi Gulati shared details about their current professional role, which primarily involves managing conferences and exhibitions, representing about 80% to 90% of their work, with additional responsibilities involving filming licenses and summer school arrangements.

* **Audience Portal Testing**: Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that the Audience and Admin portal credits have been shared with Sakshi Gulati for parallel testing. Ketan Khamgaonkar encouraged Sakshi Gulati to begin reviewing these portals to identify issues while Ketan Khamgaonkar continues development.

* **Audience Portal Navigation and Features**: During the review of the Audience portal, the participants discussed the "Discover Events" screen, which allows users to filter by location, timing, and category. They agreed to add category filtering to the top of the Discover Events page to improve user experience.

* **My Events Section Improvements**: Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed to update the "My Events" section to include distinct tabs or sections for "Upcoming Events" and "Past Events," enabling users to better track their participation history.

* **Registration Flow Adjustments**: Addressing the registration process, Sakshi Gulati expressed a preference for moving away from a single-click registration to prevent random or accidental sign-ups. They concluded that the ideal flow should redirect users to a detailed event page where they can review information, read terms and conditions, and confirm their participation intentionally.

* **Participant Selection Transparency**: Regarding the selection process for events, Sakshi Gulati emphasized the need for transparency when selecting participants from a pool, such as in random draws. They agreed that uploading screen recordings or documentation of the selection process would ensure fairness, though they noted that the visibility of personal participant data needs to be carefully managed to protect privacy.

* **Artist Profile Customization**: Reviewing the artist portal, Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar confirmed that artists should be allowed to add multiple video links to their profiles. They decided to hide the "Sponsor Perks" section on public-facing profiles to keep the view clean for general users, while ensuring sponsors retain access to this information.

* **Website URL Handling**: To improve user experience, Ketan Khamgaonkar will implement logic to handle website links automatically, so users do not need to manually include "https://" when entering URLs, ensuring uniformity across profiles.

* **Notification Clarity**: Sakshi Gulati requested that all platform notifications explicitly state which event they pertain to, as this will help users manage communications effectively when they are registered for multiple events.

* **Web Design Standards and Figma**: Ketan Khamgaonkar provided technical guidance on web design standards, specifying a 1200-pixel width for web applications and 320 to 328 pixels for mobile responsiveness. They discussed the importance of using 8-pixel or 12-pixel multiples for components, margins, and padding to maintain a professional layout. Ketan Khamgaonkar recommended using tools like Stitch with Google for Figma integration and noted that they would share resources for color combinations.

* **Missing Event Imagery**: Addressing scenarios where organizers fail to upload event images, Ketan Khamgaonkar will implement a solution to display placeholder images. They plan to use resources like Pexels to source high-quality, free-to-use images and will ensure that placeholder images can be categorized by event type, such as music or comedy.

* **Branded Email Communications**: Discussing communication with users, Sakshi Gulati and Ketan Khamgaonkar agreed that email notifications regarding event registration, participant selection, and payout confirmations should be visually branded. They decided that while the base of the email can remain constant, there should be an option to customize the content and include branding, such as logos, to provide a more professional experience. (just plan for this for now \- can be done later on as discussions proceed and we come to some final conclusions)

* **Next Steps and Scheduling**: Ketan Khamgaonkar will continue working on administrative and audience portal changes, which are expected to reflect by the following day. Sakshi Gulati committed to logging in to perform further testing on the administrative portal. The pair agreed to touch base on Monday, as Sakshi Gulati will be unavailable on Friday and Saturday, and they will continue communication via WhatsApp in the interim.
